name: Twin Mills
pattern: tutorial: two mills exactly alike; one leg gone and a mill falls forward; the hand shows the first, the second is the player's
ftip: A post holds a building up. Hit the posts.

name: Pit Head
pattern: timber headframe: two front feet side by side and it falls forward across the woodshed
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Two feet side by side. Then BLAST.

name: Hop Kiln
pattern: tutorial: two brick piers side by side drop the kiln forward across the cart lodge; one pier alone only cracks it; each cottage takes its own pier
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Two piers side by side bring it down.

name: Gas Works
pattern: steel on brick: two brick pedestals side by side lean the steel guide frame over onto the retort house
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: It stands on brick. Break two side by side.

name: Airfield Tower
pattern: tutorial: two grey columns side by side drop the tower forward across the baggage hall; one column alone only cracks it; each wing takes its own column
dud: Not yet. Two columns side by side!
ftip: Grey columns: one TNT each. Two side by side.

name: Monorail Station
pattern: support chain: the viaduct spans rest on the station platform; drop the station and both spans swing down
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: What rests on it falls with it.

name: Drive-in
pattern: a wide screen on a row of concrete footings: two side by side drop it forward across the booth; the diners take their own pier
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: A wall stands on its feet. Break two.

name: Pier Pavilion
pattern: materials ladder: concrete pile caps under steel legs under a brick and timber pavilion; two caps side by side pitch it onto the hut row
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Hit what holds it up. Two side by side.

name: Fire Station
pattern: blue intro: two brick piers tip the hose tower forward onto the engine house, away from the school; the crew house takes its own pier
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Bring it down in front. Keep the blue safe.

name: Valley Station
pattern: rotate: the front legs drop the station on the blue house; turned to the back, two legs drop it onto the ticket hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: It falls toward the legs you break. Turn around.

name: Floodlit Stand
pattern: steel on concrete + aim: each floodlight tower tipped inward through two pedestals falls across the grandstand roof
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Tall towers fall where their feet go. Aim inward.

name: Roadside Motel
pattern: rotate + dark: the sign pylon stands on dark back legs; turned to the back, two of them (more TNT each) drop it across the motel row
dud: Not yet. Dark piers need more TNT!
ftip: It falls where the legs go. Look round.

name: Needle Court
pattern: glass teach: glass panes break and carry nothing; two concrete legs side by side drop the needle onto the hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Glass breaks. It holds nothing up.

name: Doorstop Corner
pattern: rotate: the blue school in front of the glass nose, the hall behind; two back legs lay the wedge on the hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Turn the view. Blast the back.

name: Glass Point
pattern: glass holds nothing: the panes break, the concrete frame carries it; two legs side by side drop it onto the hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Glass holds nothing. Hit the frame.

name: Tock Yard
pattern: row then barrels: the clock tower tips into the row, the last house lands on the barrels, the coal shed goes
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Let the row reach the barrels.

name: Rivet Depot
pattern: barrels: a row of red barrels along the back of the depot; the lattice tower falls on them and the depot goes too
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Drop it on the barrels. They do the rest.

name: Car Park
pattern: dark piers: the car park stands on reinforced piers that take more than one TNT; two side by side tip it and the decks pancake
dud: Not yet. Dark piers need more TNT!
ftip: Break the legs. The decks come down together.

name: Library
pattern: rotate + dark: the stack tower must fall forward onto the reading hall; its front legs are only reached from the side
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Aim it at the hall. Turn the view.

name: Old Tock Row
pattern: domino: the clock tower tips forward into the first house, the row of houses falls one onto the next
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: One push. Let it fall into the row.

name: The Bullet
pattern: glass skin, ring of legs: two legs side by side and the bullet falls onto the pavilion
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Glass holds nothing. Two legs side by side.

name: Harbour Crane
pattern: steel intro: TNT on the steel legs does little; two concrete pedestals side by side drop the crane forward onto the ship; each warehouse takes its own pier
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Steel holds. Break what it stands on.

name: The Pencil
pattern: rotate: the blue school in front, the ticket hall behind; tipped back (two back legs) the pencil lies on the hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Turn the view. Blast the back.

name: Tube Bundle
pattern: tip it down the row: two legs side by side and the tube bundle lies down along the hut row in front
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Two legs side by side. It falls that way.

name: The Splinter
pattern: glass shard on concrete legs: two legs side by side and it lies down along the hut row
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Hit the frame on the side it should fall.

name: Stack Tower
pattern: stacked blocks on one storey of legs: two legs side by side and the stack pitches onto the hall
dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
ftip: Two legs side by side. It falls that way.
